limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the unregistered write-side Gray pointer but also registered the status flags using next-pointer logic and gated RAM enables with reset, changing cycle-by-cycle behavior that the reference fix preserves.
The scoreboard used the DUT's own flags to decide which transfers to expect and checked fill and drain only after waiting several cycles, so it could pass despite incorrect flag and transfer timing.

limitations.quote: fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git
limitations.note: The failed Git status check provided no information about the fix and prevented the chained directory listing from running.
An arbitrary minimum read count stopped the sweep at depth 1 even though the unchanged RTL passed that case with 361 ordered reads after the threshold was lowered.
